messages:
alex: Morning — noticed a p95/p99 latency regression on hosted API since ~03:12 UTC. Customers reporting timeouts and slow streaming. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/hosted-api-latency (p95 jumped ~600ms -> 2.8s)
sre-bot: alert: HOSTED_API_LATENCY_P99 > 3s (firing) — routed to #eng-oncall
mira: taking this. Which routes and regions are the worst?
alex: Mostly /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream. Regions: us-east-1 and eu-west-1 showing highest queuing. Traces: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/trace/xyz — long queue_time on runtime-proxy before GPU.
jess: Quick triage checklist (run in order): 1) confirm autoscaler/backlog 2) inspect queue depth & batching histograms 3) check circuit-breakers & rate-limits 4) enable model fallback for non-critical tiers 5) surface KV-cache hit-rate
samir: I can apply a fast-reject circuit for the heaviest route. Proposal: p99>2000ms -> fast-reject (return 429), p95>1000ms -> route to degraded model. Apply only to /v1/generate initially.
mira: +1. Also reduce per-key burst windows for non-enterprise keys to throttle noisy traffic. Feature flag name: rollout.service.fallbacks.enable=true (we can scope by tag).
alex: Commands I'm about to run for control-plane (devops-admin):
```bash
# set circuit breaker for generate route
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \n  https://control-plane/api/v1/configs/circuit -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","strategy":"fast-reject","p99_ms":2000}'

# enable fallback to smaller model for non-enterprise keys
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \n  https://control-plane/api/v1/configs/fallback -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback_model":"redwood/gpt-small","conditions":"tier!=enterprise"}'
```
jess: Also temporarily tighten per-key rate limits for bursty keys: set burst_window=20s and burst_tokens=100 for non-enterprise. That will reduce sudden pressure on proxies.
mira: I'm scaling dedicated-pool +2 GPUs in us-east-1 and bumping hosted-runtime autoscaler max to allow +60% capacity for 20 minutes. Starting now.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: scaled dedicated-pool/us-east-1: +2 GPUs — rollout complete
samir: After circuit + fallback + rate-limit changes: p95 dropped to ~850ms, p99 -> ~1.7s. Streaming errors mostly gone; a few enterprise customers still see elevated latency (we didn't fallback them).
alex: Root cause hypothesis: sudden surge of long-sequence chat sessions reduced KV-cache hit rate and increased per-request compute time; batching/queueing amplified tail.
jess: Action items (owners):
- mira: make circuit + fallback a templated playbook with safe defaults and telemetry hooks
- alex: customer comms + short incident note
- samir: improve prefix/KV-cache heuristics and add sequence-length histogram to Optimize dashboards
- jess: add a short lint to rollout CI to flag long-seq model rollouts that can cause cache churn
mira: I'll open a PR for the playbook and add a 'rapid-mitigation' section listing the exact commands above. Ping me for verification. :thumbsup:
